2103-2707-5795.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-2301-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-2301-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

3946-4482-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1247-2113-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

6754-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3617-4423-4426-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-4426-6886.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

104-2541-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Glint-Horn Buccaneer has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
104-2541-4869.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life plus 1.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

2104-4543-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2104-4543-6333-6678.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1479-1659-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3573-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
3573-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
3573-4067-5672.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-4659-5346-5433.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
Repeat.

1879-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2921-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-2921-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1247-2092-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
1247-2092-4474.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

751-3314-3478-3875.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

902-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have visited at least one Attraction this turn.
902-1849-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squirrel Squatters as attackers.
Squirrel Squatters triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Squirrel token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

859-3113.notablePrerequisites:
Fire Whip attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
859-3113.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

3090-4691-5165.description:
Donate control of Vilis to an opponent using Harmless Offering
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

222-4050-4314.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-4050-4314.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When the creatures die, Pawn of Ulamog triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the two Eldrazi Spawns, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

834-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Old One Eye, adding {C}{C}.
Old One Eye dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Old One Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Old One Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 5/5 Tyranid creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tyranid, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

366-1864-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
366-1864-4050.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
The Kobolds enter the battlefield, triggering Purphoros that many times, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each Kobold.
Prossh enters the battlefield, triggering Purphoros, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobolds, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all remaining Kobolds, adding {1} for each Kobold sacrificed this way.
 Repeat for each {1} additional mana you have available.

2634-3309-4821.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2634-3309-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
2634-3309-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Rootha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Repeat from step 4.

152-1608-2034.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triplicate Titan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Triplicate Titan token dies, creating three 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the three Golem tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

249-3094-4821.notablePrerequisites:
Dramatic Reversal is exiled with a kick counter on it.
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
249-3094-4821.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Zethi's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Zethi's ability, creating a copy of each card exiled with a kick counter of it and causing you to pay {1}{U} to cast the copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use that mana to then cast the copies of all other cards exiled with kick counters on them.

3605-4846.description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Dance of the Dead.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Dance of the Dead triggers, sacrificing Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate all lands you control by tapping those, adding manas of any colors those lands can produce.
Repeat.
